item.p: Specifications: XML 1.1 (Second Edition), 2.2 (Char, RestrictedChar: C0 controls only as character references, C1 controls as references), 2.11 (line ends with NEL and LINE SEPARATOR), 4.3.4 (version), 2.13 (normalization checking, optional); Namespaces in XML 1.1 (undeclaring prefixes, already done, ); Serialization 4.0, the version parameter (1.1 output, where character references are required).
xmlconf 275 (the ibm and eduni xml-1.1 catalogs; today tests/xml_conformance_test.c does not select them);
a few XSD instance failures ('s leftovers).
Replaces: XML 1.1 documents are parsed by the 1.0 rules (src/xml.c, 's place).

Mechanism: the XML grammar's external scanner takes the version from the declaration as scanner state, and checks Char and line ends by version. The tree builder is unchanged. fn:parse-xml and the drivers state the version. The serializer's version 1.1 writes references for restricted characters.
After: 7.2 (it grows the core by a few KB).
Owns: grammars/xml (scanner), src/xml.c, tests/xml_conformance_test.c (the selection), and src/serialize_xml.c (version 1.1).
Gate: ≥ 95 % of the 275 xmlconf cases; ≥ 90 % of the QT4 and XT40 cases.

body.p: Done 2026-10-19 (), gate partly met: xmlconf 242 of 271 XML 1.1 cases (89.3 %; every case without external entities passes, the 29 failures need external entities or DTDs, which is 7.14's); QT4 XQ40 300 of 313 (95.8 %; the 13 need XQuery's own 1.1 lexing, Proposed); XT40 xml-version 40 of 42, 65 XML_1.1 cases now run. The grammar is unchanged: a 1.1 pre-pass in src/xml.c instead of scanner state.
